Adding the infra view.

- Confirming latency P99/P99.9 drift: we see a spike at ~06/22 03:10–04:40 UTC. The change correlates with a GPU kernel selector patch that landed in the serving runtime (rev: runtime-2.14.7). That patch favors a different kernel on A100s under long-seq workloads which increased model activation time for some transformer configs.
- Short-term mitigation: force older kernel via config override on the affected pools (will cost ~5% throughput temporarily). Long-term: compiler team will test the new kernel with better micro-batching heuristics.

I've attached the raw p99 breakdown CSV and a short snippet of the profile showing the kernel switch times.

Markus
